PastML.ambiguity_rule: N at either endpoint emits no discrete branch event

reason: Runner implementation authorizations v1 and v2 were both superseded before use by frozen upstream interface amendments. Output normalization and the final POUTINE physical-position map serializer are now frozen. This v3 authorization pins the complete comparator input/output adapter layer and authorizes implementation of the reusable truth-blind comparator benchmark runner.
requirements: Implement one reusable runner covering exactly ARPIP, FastML, HomoplasyFinder, PAML, PastML, POUTINE, SNPPar and TreeTime.
Do not execute any frozen canonical S001-S150 benchmark scenario during runner implementation or validation.
Do not execute any third-party comparator during runner implementation or validation.
Do not read canonical benchmark truth during runner implementation or validation.
Comparator execution and prediction normalization must be structurally truth-blind.
Truth paths, truth objects and truth-derived values must not enter comparator command construction, subprocess environments, comparator execution, native-output parsing or prediction normalization.
Use only frozen environment/run contracts and frozen adapter functions for comparator-specific input serialization and output normalization.
Do not duplicate scientific adapter logic inside the runner.
Executable, environment, source and build paths must be runtime supplied; do not hard-code /home/rwhite/branchsnv-comparator-* locations.
Use isolated method-by-scenario working directories.
Fail closed if a requested result root already exists.
Preserve executed command metadata, exit status, stdout, stderr and native comparator outputs.
Record timeout, non-zero exit status, missing required output, malformed output and normalization failure as explicit completion failures.
Never convert comparator execution or normalization failure into a zero-accuracy prediction.
Separate comparator execution and prediction normalization from truth scoring.
Normalized predictions must be finalized before truth is supplied to any later scoring phase.
Use the frozen metric functions unchanged.
Synthetic runner validation must use temporary synthetic fixtures only and must not reference S001-S150.
Fail closed on unknown methods, missing comparator-facing inputs, malformed runtime configuration, unexpected native-output state or frozen-identity mismatch.
Cross-tool branch identity must use the frozen canonical descendant-tip edge identity; comparator-specific internal node labels must never be treated as cross-tool branch identifiers.

PastML must use reconstructed_states.tsv plus named.tree_tree.nwk, map nodes by descendant-tip identity, and normalize projected states back to genomic positions using events_from_projected_node_sequences().
POUTINE projected FASTA input must use poutine_variant_fasta_text().
POUTINE phenotype input must use poutine_dummy_phenotype_text().
POUTINE physical-position map input must use poutine_physical_positions_map_text().
POUTINE homoplasy output must be normalized using parse_poutine_result().
SNPPar branch events must use parse_snppar_mutation_events().
SNPPar recurrent-site calls must use snppar_recurrent_sites_from_branch_events() on normalized events originating from homoplasic_events_all_calls.tsv.
TreeTime ancestral node sequences may be mapped using map_node_sequences_by_descendant_tips().
TreeTime recurrent-site calls must use treetime_recurrent_sites_from_branch_events() on normalized ancestral branch events.
Do not execute or score TreeTime homoplasy top-N output.
PAML, ARPIP and FastML ancestral reconstructions must use their frozen node-sequence normalization helpers rather than raw internal node labels.
HomoplasyFinder recurrent-site output must use the frozen HomoplasyFinder parser.
Runner validation may mock subprocess execution but must not invoke real comparator binaries.
